Usage: zealakit [options] [command] [project-name]

Recipe-based project scaffolding. Prefer `zealakit create` (supports --discover
and --template). The root form `zealakit [name] -t …` is deprecated.

Arguments:
  project-name                     Project name (npm naming rules)

Options:
  -V, --version                    output the version number
  -t, --template <template>        Choose a base template yourself (default:
                                   vite-react). Available: vite-react, vite-vue,
                                   vite-svelte, astro-react-client,
                                   astro-react-hybrid, next, nuxt, nest, hono,
                                   stdlib-api, gin-api, stdlib-worker
  -w, --with <recipes>             Recipes to apply, comma-separated (e.g.
                                   biome). Available: biome, eslint, zustand,
                                   pinia, nanostores, client-shared-pieces,
                                   hookform-zod, vee-validate-zod, kyjs, axios,
                                   tanstack-query, antd, mui, shadcn-ui,
                                   nuxt-ui, shadcn-vue, storybook, vitest,
                                   docker, better-auth, nest-auth,
                                   github-actions, type-orm, mikro-orm,
                                   drizzle-orm, prisma, postgres, mysql,
                                   mongodb, docker-go, github-actions-go, goose,
                                   sqlc, redis
  -y, --yes                        Non-interactive: never prompt; refuses a
                                   non-empty target
  --force                          Overwrite a non-empty target directory
                                   without asking
  --dry-run                        Resolve and validate without writing files
  --pm <manager>                   Package manager for install and next steps:
                                   npm, pnpm, yarn, bun (default: detected)
  --install                        Install dependencies after generating (go mod
                                   tidy for Go)
  --no-install                     Do not install dependencies
  --git                            Run git init and make an initial commit
  --no-git                         Do not initialize a git repository
  --no-manifest                    Do not write zealakit.json into the project
  --config <file>                  Config file with `defaults` and `presets`
                                   (highest precedence over project/user config)
  --preset <name>                  Apply a saved preset (see `zealakit preset
                                   list`); flags override it
  --save-preset <name>             Save the chosen template and recipes as a
                                   user preset
  --discover                       Project Discovery: answer a few questions and
                                   get template/recipe recommendations
  --info                           Print kit metadata (alias of `zealakit info`)
  --json                           With --info: print only machine-readable JSON
  -h, --help                       display help for command

Commands:
  create [options] [project-name]  Create a new project. Modes: interactive
                                   prompts, --discover (recommendations), or
                                   --template <id>.
  info [options]                   Print kit metadata: templates, recipes,
                                   ecosystems, categories, Discovery profiles
  doctor [options]                 Check Zealakit runtime and optional Go
                                   toolchain availability
  discovery                        Local Project Discovery feedback and
                                   stateless JSON queries (offline; no network
                                   uploads)
  preset                           Manage saved create presets (user-level plus
                                   ./zealakit.config.json)
  add [options] <recipes...>       Add recipes to an existing project (reads
                                   zealakit.json; previews a diff first)
  outdated [options]               Compare this project's template/recipe
                                   dependency ranges with the installed kit
                                   (report only)
